subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltulas in patches of soil can be found by catching bugs from under rocks and dropping them on the soil.

evidence.quote: To find the Skulltulas in the patches of soil, catch some bugs from under the rocks and plop them on the soil.

subject: Market
text: Link can easily collect 100 rupees as Young Link by breaking all the pots in the room at the entrance to the Market.

evidence.quote: The easiest way to get rupees to play the minigames and purchase items is to break all the pots in the room at the entrance to the Market as Young Link; you can rack up 100 rupees pretty easily that way.

subject: Kokiri Forest
text: A treasure chest reached by crawling through the tiny hole in the southwest corner of Kokiri Forest contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: Enter the tiny hole here and crawl through it.  Go left, and follow the path to the treasure chest while avoiding the boulders.  It contains the Kokiri Sword.

subject: Deku Shield
text: The Deku Shield can be purchased for 40 rupees at the item shop in the northeast corner of Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Collect rupees in the grass, in the house of Mido, and under rocks and bushes until you have 40.  Then, enter the item shop in the northeast corner of this section of the forest and purchase the Deku Shield.

subject: Gohma
text: To defeat Gohma, find it on the ceiling, stun it by shooting its eye with the Slingshot, and slash it with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat the Gohma boss, first locate it on the ceiling.  Shoot at its eye with the Slingshot to stun it, then slice it up with your sword.  Repeat until it dies.

subject: Deku Tree
text: A treasure chest around the perimeter of the 2nd floor ledge contains the dungeon map.

evidence.quote: climb up the ladder to the left to the 2nd floor...Go around the perimeter of the ledge and get the map from the chest.

subject: Deku Tree
text: Jumping across the platform in the room past the 2nd floor ledge leads to a treasure chest containing the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Continue around the ledges and go to the next room...Jump across the platform and get the Fairy Slingshot from the chest.

subject: Deku Tree
text: Stepping on the switch and jumping to the opposite ledge on the 3rd floor leads to a chest containing the compass.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch and jump to the ledge on the opposite side, then get the compass from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Stepping on the switch and jumping to the opening in the wall leads to Gold Skulltula (#1) and its token.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch, jump to the first platform, then jump left to the 
  opening in the wall, kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) and get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On floor B1, defeating Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines with the Slingshot allows Link to climb up and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Use the Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines, then 
  climb up to get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Killing Gold Skulltula (#3) on the metal grating on floor B1 allows Link to jump from a nearby ledge to obtain its token.

evidence.quote:
Find the Gold Skulltula (#3) on the metal grating, kill it, then jump 
  from the nearby ledge to get the token.

subject: Deku Scrubs
text: To access the boss room from floor B2, hit the middle Deku Scrub, then the right-hand one, then the left-hand one.

evidence.quote:
Hit the middle Deku, then the right-hand one, then the left-hand one, and
  go to the next room to get to the boss.
